name: Rhode Island: SBC-2 Rhode Island One & Two Family Dwelling Code

review.note: Adopts IRC 2021 (Building Code Standards Committee, RI Building Code Commission; 510-RICR-00-00-2). State amendments to the checked rules: riser height, tread depth. Amendments were researched for stairs, ceiling height, light and ventilation only; every other rule (room size, egress, escape openings, electrical, alarms) is the base code's. Entered 2026-10-27 (research confidence: high); not yet…
